questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If \( 2(x-6) = 3x-5 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** -7. Distribute: \( 2x-12 = 3x-5 \). \( -x = -5 + 12 \Rightarrow x=-7 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: \[ \begin{cases}x+6y=-43\\-x-y=13\end{cases} \] What is the value of \( y \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** -6. Adding the equations eliminates \( x \): \( 5y=-30 \Rightarrow y=-6 \). Then \( x=-7 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: \[ \begin{cases}6x-3y=-6\\-6x+5y=-2\end{cases} \] What is the value of \( y \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** -4. Adding the equations eliminates \( x \): \( 2y=-8 \Rightarrow y=-4 \). Then \( x=-3 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If \( 3(x-2) = -3x-12 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** -1. Distribute: \( 3x-6 = -3x-12 \). \( 6x = -12 + 6 \Rightarrow x=-1 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If \( 2x+5 = -5x+47 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 6. Applying Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations principles, \( 7x = 47 - 5 \Rightarrow x = 6 \) Therefore, the verified correct option is 6.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If \( 6(x+1) = -x+20 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 2. Distribute: \( 6x+6 = -x+20 \). \( 7x = 20 - 6 \Rightarrow x=2 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: What is the sum of all solutions to \( |3x - 9| = 15 \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 6. Two cases: \( 3x - 9 = 15 \implies 3x = 24 \implies x = 8 \); and \( 3x - 9 = -15 \implies 3x = -6 \implies x = -2 \). The sum of solutions is \( 8 + (-2) = 6 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: What is the positive solution to \( |2x - 4| = 12 \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 8. \( 2x - 4 = 12 \implies 2x = 16 \implies x = 8 \). (The negative solution is \( 2x - 4 = -12 \implies x = -4 \)).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: A two-digit number has a tens digit \( t \) and a units digit \( u \). The sum of the digits is 11. If the digits are reversed, the new number is 27 greater than the original. What was the original number?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 47. \( t + u = 11 \) and \( (10u + t) - (10t + u) = 27 \implies 9u - 9t = 27 \implies u - t = 3 \). Adding equations gives \( 2u = 14 \implies u = 7, t = 4 \). Original number is 47.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: A farmer has chickens and cows. In total, there are 30 heads and 84 legs. How many cows does the farmer have?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 12. Let \( c \) be chickens and \( w \) be cows. \( c + w = 30 \implies 2c + 2w = 60 \). Legs: \( 2c + 4w = 84 \). Subtract: \( 2w = 24 \implies w = 12 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: A store sells notebooks for $3 each and pens for $1.50 each. Maria spent $18 on a total of 8 items. How many notebooks did she buy?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 4. Let \( n \) = notebooks: \( 3n+1.5(8-n)=18 \Rightarrow 1.5n=6 \Rightarrow n=4 \).

questions.answer: **Answer:** -4. Solving the system by elimination gives \( x=-4 \) and \( y=-8 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: \[ \begin{cases}3x-y=-6\\-7x-4y=-24\end{cases} \] What is the value of \( x \)?

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: \[ \begin{cases}-4x+4y=-28\\-x-7y=1\end{cases} \] What is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 6. Solving the system by elimination gives \( x=6 \) and \( y=-1 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If \( 3x - 2y = 9 \) and \( x + 4y = 17 \), what is the value of \( 5x + 6y \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 43. Multiply the second equation by 2: \( 2x + 8y = 34 \). Add to first: \( (3x - 2y) + (2x + 8y) = 9 + 34 \implies 5x + 6y = 43 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If \( \begin{cases} ax + by = 12 \\ 4a + 3b = 16 \end{cases} \) and \( x = 2, y = 3 \), what is the value of \( a \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 2. Substitute \( x = 2, y = 3 \) into the first equation: \( 2a + 3b = 12 \). Subtract this from \( 4a + 3b = 16 \): \( (4a + 3b) - (2a + 3b) = 16 - 12 \implies 2a = 4 \implies a = 2 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If \( \begin{cases} 3x - 4y = 7 \\ 2x + 3y = 16 \end{cases} \), what is the value of \( x^2 - y^2 \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 21. Multiply first equation by 3: \( 9x - 12y = 21 \). Multiply second equation by 4: \( 8x + 12y = 64 \). Add: \( 17x = 85 \implies x = 5 \). Then \( 2(5) + 3y = 16 \implies 3y = 6 \implies y = 2 \). Thus \( x^2 - y^2 = 5^2 - 2^2 = 25 - 4 = 21 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: In the system \( \begin{cases} mx + 3y = 9 \\ 4x + 6y = 18 \end{cases} \), for what value of \( m \) does the system have infinitely many solutions?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 2. Multiply first equation by 2: \( 2mx + 6y = 18 \). Matching with \( 4x + 6y = 18 \) requires \( 2m = 4 \implies m = 2 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: A barge travels 36 miles upstream in 4 hours and returns 36 miles downstream in 2 hours. What is the speed of the current in miles per hour?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 4.5. Let \( b \) be barge speed and \( c \) be current speed. Upstream: \( b - c = 36/4 = 9 \). Downstream: \( b + c = 36/2 = 18 \). Subtract first from second: \( 2c = 9 \implies c = 4.5 \) mph.

questions.q: If \( 3x + 14 = 32 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: Subtract 14 from both sides to get \( 3x = 18 \), then divide by 3: \( x = 6 \).

questions.q: If \( 2(x - 8) = 8 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: Divide both sides by 2: \( x - 8 = 4 \). Add 8: \( x = 12 \).

questions.q: A moving company charges a one-time fee of $30 plus $55 per mile. If the total charge was $305, how many miles was the move?
questions.answer: Let \( n \) be the number of miles. Then \( 30 + 55n = 305 \), so \( 55n = 275 \) and \( n = 5 \).

questions.q: If \( \frac{x}{3} + 5 = 13 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: Subtract 5: \( \frac{x}{3} = 8 \). Multiply by 3: \( x = 24 \).

questions.q: If \( 8x + 12 = 4x + 36 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: Subtract \( 4x \) and 12 from both sides: \( 4x = 24 \), so \( x = 6 \).

questions.q: Suppose that \( 5x = 15 \), what is the value of \( 10x \)?
questions.answer: Multiply both sides of \( 5x = 15 \) by 2: \( 10x = 30 \).

questions.q: A taxi company charges a one-time fee of $25 plus $30 per mile. If the total charge was $175, how many miles was the trip?
questions.answer: Let \( n \) be the number of miles. Then \( 25 + 30n = 175 \), so \( 30n = 150 \) and \( n = 5 \).

questions.q: Suppose that \( \frac{x}{2} + 3 = 9 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: Subtract 3: \( \frac{x}{2} = 6 \). Multiply by 2: \( x = 12 \).

questions.q: Suppose that \( 5x + 14 = 2x + 38 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: Subtract \( 2x \) and 14 from both sides: \( 3x = 24 \), so \( x = 8 \).

questions.q: Assuming that \( 4(x - 1) = 16 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: Divide both sides by 4: \( x - 1 = 4 \). Add 1: \( x = 5 \).

questions.q: A tutoring center charges a one-time fee of $20 plus $60 per session. If the total charge was $260, how many sessions did the student attend?
questions.answer: Let \( n \) be the number of sessions. Then \( 20 + 60n = 260 \), so \( 60n = 240 \) and \( n = 4 \).

questions.q: Assuming that \( 6x + 7 = 3x + 37 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: Subtract \( 3x \) and 7 from both sides: \( 3x = 30 \), so \( x = 10 \).

questions.q: Under the condition that \( 4x = 8 \), what is the value of \( 8x \)?
questions.answer: Multiply both sides of \( 4x = 8 \) by 2: \( 8x = 16 \).

questions.q: A tutoring center charges a one-time fee of $50 plus $65 per session. If the total charge was $310, how many sessions did the student attend?
questions.answer: Let \( n \) be the number of sessions. Then \( 50 + 65n = 310 \), so \( 65n = 260 \) and \( n = 4 \).

questions.q: Under the condition that \( 6x + 8 = 5x + 13 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: Subtract \( 5x \) and 8 from both sides: \( 1x = 5 \), so \( x = 5 \).

questions.q: Provided that \( 4(x - 9) = 48 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: Divide both sides by 4: \( x - 9 = 12 \). Add 9: \( x = 21 \).

questions.q: A taxi company charges a one-time fee of $30 plus $40 per mile. If the total charge was $150, how many miles was the trip?
questions.answer: Let \( n \) be the number of miles. Then \( 30 + 40n = 150 \), so \( 40n = 120 \) and \( n = 3 \).

questions.q: Which values of \( x \) satisfy \( -2x+3>7 \)?
questions.answer: Applying Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities principles, \( -2x>4 \Rightarrow x<-2 \) Therefore, the verified correct option is \( x<-2 \).

questions.q: The graph of a function is shown. At which x-value does the function equal zero?
questions.answer: The zero (x-intercept) is where the graph crosses the x-axis: \( x=2 \).

questions.q: A line in the \( xy \)-plane has a slope of \( 3 \) and passes through the point \( (2, 11) \). Which equation represents this line?
questions.answer: Using point-slope form: \( y - 11 = 3(x - 2) \Rightarrow y = 3x - 6 + 11 = 3x + 5 \).

questions.q: Which of the following equations represents a horizontal line passing through the point \( (3, -5) \)?
questions.answer: A horizontal line has slope 0 and an equation of the form \( y = c \). Since it passes through \( (3, -5) \), the equation is \( y = -5 \).

questions.q: A gym charges a monthly membership fee of \( \$30 \) plus \( \$2 \) for each fitness class attended. If a member attends \( c \) fitness classes in a month, which expression represents the member's total cost for that month?
questions.answer: The base monthly fee is \( 30 \) and the variable fee is \( 2c \), giving \( 30 + 2c \).

questions.q: A line has equation \( y = -4x + 9 \). What is the \( y \)-intercept of the line?
questions.answer: In slope-intercept form \( y = mx + b \), the y-intercept is \( (0, b) = (0, 9) \).

questions.q: Which inequality represents all values of \( x \) such that \( 4x - 5 \leq 19 \)?
questions.answer: Add 5: \( 4x \leq 24 \). Divide by 4: \( x \leq 6 \).

questions.q: What is the slope of the line \( 2x + 5y = 20 \)?
questions.answer: Solve for \( y \): \( 5y = -2x + 20 \implies y = -\dfrac{2}{5}x + 4 \). The slope is \( -\dfrac{2}{5} \).
